hypotheses.B1_random_starts_improve_heldout_fisher: Every random-start fit reduces its opposite-half Fisher error by at least 15% relative to Frobenius rank eight.
hypotheses.B2_random_fits_recover_same_subspace: Every pair of random-start fits has mean canonical cosine at least 0.80.
hypotheses.B3_random_fits_match_prefix_solution: Every random-start fit has mean canonical cosine at least 0.80 to the primary prefix-initialized solution.
hypotheses.B4_random_improvement_transfers: Every random-start fit has lower mean exact KL than Frobenius rank eight on every evaluation corpus.
hypotheses.B5_adversarial_start_escapes: The orthogonal-to-prefix start improves held-out Fisher by at least 15% and reaches mean canonical cosine at least 0.80 to the prefix solution.
hypotheses.B6_random_solution_reaches_gate: At least one random-start rank-eight fit has median exact KL at most 0.005 on every corpus.
